title: AudioTurbo: Fast Text-to-Audio Generation with Rectified Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2505.22106v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have significantly improved the quality and diversity of text-to-audio (TTA) generation but are hindered by slow inference speed. Recent flow-based approaches have been explored for accelerating TTA generation. However, these approaches typically rely on dedicated flow-based generative frameworks and do not directly exploit existing pre-trained diffusion-based TTA models. To address this limitation while leveraging the strong generative capabilities of pre-trained diffusion models, we integrate rectified diffusion into these models to improve TTA generation efficiency. Specifically, we propose AudioTurbo, which learns first-order approximate ordinary differential equation (ODE) paths from deterministic noise-sample pairs generated by a pre-trained TTA model. Experiments show that our approach outperforms a flow-matching-based acceleration model in both generation quality and inference speed.

translated_title: AudioTurbo：基于校正扩散的快速文本到音频生成
translated_abstract: 扩散模型显著提升了文本到音频（TTA）生成的质量和多样性，但受限于缓慢的推理速度。近年来，研究者探索了基于流的方法来加速TTA生成。然而，这些方法通常依赖于专用的基于流的生成框架，无法直接利用现有的预训练扩散式TTA模型。为了解决这一局限性，同时充分利用预训练扩散模型的强大生成能力，我们将校正扩散集成到这些模型中，以提高TTA生成效率。具体而言，我们提出了AudioTurbo，它从预训练TTA模型生成的确定性噪声-样本对中学习一阶近似常微分方程（ODE）路径。实验表明，我们的方法在生成质量和推理速度方面均优于基于流匹配的加速模型。
tldr: 提出AudioTurbo，将校正扩散集成到预训练扩散式TTA模型中，通过从确定性噪声-样本对学习一阶近似ODE路径，在生成质量和推理速度上均超越基于流匹配的加速方法。
en_tdlr: AudioTurbo integrates rectified diffusion into pre-trained diffusion-based TTA models by learning first-order approximate ODE paths from deterministic noise-sample pairs, outperforming flow-matching-based acceleration methods in both generation quality and inference speed.
